sample: 430 repos stratified by Show HN points band (1-49/50-199/200-499/500+) and year (2024/2025/2026) from 19,983 unique github-linked Show HN posts in the companion dataset showhn-24mo (70,894 posts, Oct 2024 - Oct 2026)
attrition: 12/430 (2.8%) returned HTTP 404 (deleted/private since posting) and are excluded; 0 forks; 7 archived
verification: 5/5 random rows re-fetched against the live API matched exactly (created_at + stargazers_count)
why_launch_age: GitHub restricted /repos/{o}/{r}/stargazers (and the star+json media type, and the GraphQL stargazers connection) to admins and collaborators in July 2026 (changelog 2026-06-30, measured live 2026-10-11: 401 unauth, 404 authed non-collaborator, connection totalCount 0 even on torvalds/linux). Star-history trajectories are no longer buildable from the public API; launch age still is.

headline.claim: Top-decile Show HN launches (within-year percentile >= 0.90, inflation-proof) are built on much younger repos
headline.why_secondary: absolute point thresholds are not comparable across years (HN vote growth); the percentile definition is
headline.framing: repos get created closer to launch (time-to-publish), never 'products are built in days'; created_at is NOT reset by transfer/rename/visibility changes (only delete+recreate)
